verdict.rationale: Jira's Rovo AI docs claim automated task breakdown, auto-assignment to the right person, and trend/bottleneck identification, which loosely supports AI-driven triage/prioritization workflows, but no evidence specifically addresses bug triage or priority scoring for incoming issues. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI triaging/prioritizing bugs specifically, independent/hands-on corroboration of Rovo AI's triage accuracy, and any community validation of this workflow.
